author: Praxis II
title: BRBG-AR(interactions, zeros-only): B×fraction_zeros + DAQB
abstract: Isolate sparsity covariate: design = [B, B×fraction_zeros]; counts disabled. Ridge l2=1e-3; residualization schedule and DAQB unchanged (λ=0.7, γ_max=0.74; δ=0.15, k_density=20; k=48). Tests whether sparsity alone is responsible for Cell_cycle degradation.
